purpose: First North America land tranche. Modern 2026 administrative boundaries are source geometry only; large units are subdivided and neighbouring source units may be recombined into durable gameplay regions suitable for Bronze Age starts and alternate history.
principles: Modern national, state and provincial borders are not historical political borders.
Prefer coherent coasts, river basins, plains, mountain corridors, lake systems and peninsulas over administrative fidelity.
Split very large modern units before clustering so Alaska, northern Canada and the western United States do not become giant single gameplay regions.
Allow small modern units to merge into larger gameplay regions where geography supports it.
Retain islands and peninsulas when water separation or chokepoint geography makes them strategically meaningful.
This is a first-pass physical geography layer; Indigenous polities, culture and language are simulated separately and are not frozen into region borders.
